instruction: Turn off the sound effects for system events and notifications.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling system event sounds by setting org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds to false. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.
